name: 3jigen Shoujo o Hogo Shimashita
source:
Rokurou is a self-proclaimed "defender of my home" (in other words he's a hikikomori, and an eroge otaku to boot). One day, when he is at a book store, he meets a girl, Sara. She follows him around and finally comes to his house. 

"I'll be in trouble if my parents know it..." It looks like she never leaves. "This is why I don't like 3D girls..." He tries to get rid of her, but Sara always sexually seduces him... 

Will he be able to bear his libido and her sexual advances...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
六郎自封“居家警备员”——说白了就是个足不出户的家里蹲，外加死忠美少女游戏宅。某天，他在书店偶遇一名叫沙罗的少女，谁知对方竟一路尾随，最后径直跟进了他的家门。

“要是被爸妈发现，我就麻烦大了……”看架势，她压根没有离开的意思。“所以我才讨厌三次元女人啊……”六郎百般设法想要赶她走，沙罗却总以大胆的色诱纠缠不休……

面对汹涌的本能冲动与少女接二连三的诱惑，六郎究竟能否把持得住……？

[译自ErogeShop]
